title: Policy check removed from PostController::update
description: A refactor of the post update action removes the policy check that restricted updates to users authorised for the post.
context: The application uses Laravel policies. PostPolicy::update() exists and is registered. The route is inside the 'auth' middleware group, so the user is authenticated but not necessarily the owner of the post.

expected_findings.description: The $this->authorize('update', $post) call was removed, so any authenticated user can update any post.
